messages:
maya: Heads-up — saw an unexpected APAC egress billing line in last night's export, ~12k USD.
liam: whoa, link?
maya: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/export?proj=redwood-prod — look at 2026-03-16 US->APAC egress tag
liam: ok pulling the CSV now, will post snippet
billing-bot: ALERT: network-egress anomaly: project=redwood-prod region=SFO->SIN bytes=1.2e11 cost_usd=12045 threshold=5000
andre: Did we trigger model cold-start fallback to SFO replicas? That would cause a ton of cross-region weight pulls.
sofia: I saw pods in sin-agent pool with high podStartupLatency and frequent 502s around 03:40 UTC. kube-proxy logs show connect timeouts to local model-cache.
maya: initial hypothesis: cache warmup failing, nodes fallback to SFO hostgroup for model blobs => egress.
liam: quick costing math: committing a single A40-equivalent in SIN reserved monthly ~13k USD (on our quote), but avoids egress continuing. If demand steady, commit might be cheaper.
andre: but APAC reserved per-GPU is +8% vs US list. Need to compare: monthly reserved + infra overhead vs ongoing egress runrate. I'll model 3 scenarios: no-commit (egress), small-commit (cache nodes only), full-commit (dedicated pool).
sofia: short-term mitigation: adjust nodegroup startup to prefetch model tarball from local S3-mirroring in SIN rather than pulling from SFO. That should stop a repeat immediately.
maya: agree. Can we gate it with rollout flag? don't want to risk cold starts causing other errors.
andre: plan: 1) toggle prefetch feature flag for sin-agent (canary 10% nodes) 2) run billing-query to isolate affected jobs by job_id 3) sim commit cost vs egress for 6/12 months and present to finops.
liam: I'll run the billing delta and project the 6/12 mo break-even. Also opening ticket with cloud billing: "Unexpected cross-region egress spike 2026-03-16" and requesting line-level logs.
sofia: I made a quick k8s patch that retries the prewarm on 5s backoff and avoids falling back to remote hostgroup if prewarm fails — will post PR in 5.
andre: PR looks good, maya can you approve the canary? If green we roll to 100% and then evaluate reserve proposal.
maya: Approved for canary. Action items: @andre model commit math, @liam billing projection + ticket, @sofia deploy retry patch, @maya monitor costs and open a follow-up decision thread.
liam: one more ask — include egress-latency metric in the dashboard so product teams can correlate quality regressions with egress spikes :eyes:
billing-bot: TICKET CREATED: case-5124 "APAC egress anomaly" assigned to cloud-billing-team
maya: thanks all. Will reconvene tomorrow 10:30 PT with numbers.
